Product Features

  • Dimensions: 70 x 70 x 45 cm. This square coffee table with a fold-up tabletop can be folded up to 59 cm, making it perfect for the living room. It creates a tidy space without taking up too much space. The modern, minimalist black high-gloss coffee table is the perfect complement to the living room sofa.
  • High Gloss Material: This living room coffee table has a high-quality high gloss finish, which makes it smooth and easy to clean. Note: The living room coffee table comes with a protective film that should be removed after assembly. (The high-gloss finish is limited to the tabletop, edge, and drawers.)
  • Hidden storage: A hidden compartment under the tabletop provides space for frequently used items such as magazines, laptops and chess sets. This reduces clutter and ensures a tidy living room at all times.
  • Storage: The bottom drawer is perfect for snacks and books, while the drawers offer optimal space and clutter-free storage. It offers both hidden storage space and additional drawer storage space.
  • Swivel function: The tabletop of this coffee table can be rotated 360 degrees. Its ingenious design not only increases interactivity, but also makes it comfortable to use and an interesting work of art.
  • Lifting function: The tabletop can be raised and lowered, easily transforming it into a work surface in the living room or dining table. Hidden storage easily meets your daily needs.
  • Spacious tabletop: The tabletop measures 70 x 70 cm, making it spacious enough for leisure and work. It meets your daily needs at home without taking up too much space.
  • High Quality: Made of high-quality polycarbonate sheet, it can withstand a load of up to 30kg. The stable, wobble-free substructure does not deform even after prolonged use.
  • Multifunctionality: This coffee table not only provides storage and storage for everyday use, but also features a Kotai Haoseng tabletop for extra hidden storage. Thanks to its swivel function, it is versatile, making it the perfect choice for your home.
